restaurant_name: Adrian Sinna Animal Behavior Rehabilitation & Psychology Training Center.
text:
I rescued a four week old mixed Bangkaew pup with incredible energy. Even after 3 long walks a day he was becoming a handful. Thanks to Adrian we addressed how to work on this problem. We did a lot of work off the lead which suits this dog well. I learnt Sammy needs to run, he listens well to commands like this. We covered leading, feeding issues, socialization, pulling on the lead, bikes, cats, cars and problems in the house. Jumping up at people was also a big issue. My over friendly dog is now improving really well with constant training.
Thank you Adrian I now get staff saying how good he is.
Sandra

restaurant_name: Adrian Sinna Animal Behavior Rehabilitation & Psychology Training Center.
text: Adrian Sinna is on top of being a true professional one of the kindest persons I have had the pleasure to meet. The way he made a person really scared of dogs and a somehow aggressive and unsecure dog to bond is nothing short of a miracle. Not only did he handle the situation at hand, he also went all the way advising on the dogs health and treatment , accompanied us to the animal clinic etc. If you have any issues with a dog, or any other animal I assume, behavior Adrian is the person to contact. There's not words enough to express, especially from Noom and Tan, how grateful we are.
